description: Lockfile vulnerability audit (multi-ecosystem) — Audit a whole dependency lockfile for known vulnerabilities in one call. Pass content= (lockfile text), url= (raw or GitHub blob URL) or packages=npm:lodash@4.17.15,pypi:django@3.2.1. Auto-detects package-lock.json (v1-v3), yarn.lock (classic + berry), pnpm-lock.yaml, requirements.txt, Pipfile.lock, poetry.lock, uv.lock, Cargo.lock, go.sum, go.mod, Gemfile.lock and composer.lock (or set type=). Checks up to 2,000 pinned packages against OSV.dev in batch, de-duplicates GHSA/CVE aliases, and returns per-package max severity (CVSS 3 computed when no label), advisory IDs, fixed-in versions, the minimum safe upgrade, a CLEAN/REVIEW/UPGRADE NOW verdict and a Markdown table. Unpinned requirements are listed separately. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).

content.description: lodash==... or the full text of package-lock.json / requirements.txt / go.sum

name: dev_lockfile_audit
